items.name: Sales Navigator optional ROI
items.reason: Optional existing-license signal source only when incremental cost is zero and measured ROI evidence exists. It is not a mandatory dependency and no new subscription is justified by this block.

items.name: Gojiberry patterns
items.reason: Deterministic zero-cost company-level intent and ICP prioritization patterns are already integrated locally. The paid provider/outreach runtime is deliberately not imported.

items.name: MasLeads concept
items.reason: Company-visitor intent/fit concepts are represented as deterministic local policy. No external provider dependency, person-level enrichment or outreach is activated.

items.name: Pearl Diver concept
items.reason: Company-level first-party resolution can be planned, but person/cross-device/anonymous third-party resolution is privacy-sensitive, requires legal review and cannot use fingerprinting or covert deanonymization. The external concept remains held.

items.name: Beton Inspector LAB
items.reason: Self-hostable revenue-intelligence benchmark only. No code is imported or executed and no PostHog/CRM dependency is activated.
